feature_docs.title: Age in months
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Controls for rapid language development across early childhood.
feature_docs.caveat: Age distributions differ by corpus; do not interpret as ASD signal alone.

feature_docs.title: Child utterances
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Higher participation can reflect richer communicative engagement.
feature_docs.caveat: Session length and examiner style can strongly affect this count.

feature_docs.title: MLU in morphemes
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Classic child-language marker for grammatical development.
feature_docs.caveat: Language-specific morphology and transcript quality matter.

feature_docs.title: MLU in words
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Simpler length marker that remains useful when morphology is noisy.
feature_docs.caveat: Can be inflated by repeated phrases or examiner prompting.

feature_docs.title: Type-token ratio
feature_docs.formula: Unique words divided by total words
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Approximates vocabulary diversity in the transcript.
feature_docs.caveat: Sensitive to transcript length; compare similar session lengths.

feature_docs.title: Total child words
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Proxy for expressive language production during the session.
feature_docs.caveat: Depends on recording duration and conversational context.

feature_docs.title: Unintelligible utterances
feature_docs.formula: Count of utterances with xxx/yyy markers
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Flags speech/transcript portions that could not be understood.
feature_docs.caveat: ASR may under-detect unintelligible speech unless human reviewed.

feature_docs.title: Unintelligible ratio
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Normalizes intelligibility issues by session size.
feature_docs.caveat: Use with audio quality and transcript confidence.

feature_docs.title: Zero vocalizations
feature_docs.formula: Count of child tiers coded as 0 .
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Captures moments with no spoken response in CHAT annotation.
feature_docs.caveat: May reflect task demands rather than child ability.

feature_docs.title: Non-verbal vocalizations
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Captures vocal behavior that is not lexical speech.
feature_docs.caveat: Some non-verbal vocalizations are social and positive.

feature_docs.title: Question ratio
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Approximates social initiation and pragmatic language.
feature_docs.caveat: Depends on the interaction task and examiner prompting.

feature_docs.title: Echolalia count
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Captures repetition patterns discussed in ASD language literature.
feature_docs.caveat: Rule-based detection needs human transcript review for clinical use.

feature_docs.title: Echolalia ratio
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Normalizes repetition markers across session lengths.
feature_docs.caveat: Short transcripts can make the ratio unstable.

feature_docs.title: Pronoun reversal count
feature_docs.formula: Conservative count of obvious I/you, me/you, or my/your reversals
feature_docs.clinical_meaning: Flags a pragmatic-language pattern discussed in ASD language review.
feature_docs.caveat: Heuristic only; many pronoun uses are context-dependent and need human review.

optional_indicator_docs.title: Long pause count
optional_indicator_docs.formula: Count of gaps longer than the configured pause threshold
optional_indicator_docs.clinical_meaning: Adds context about conversational flow and response timing.
optional_indicator_docs.caveat: Requires reliable timestamps and task context.

optional_indicator_docs.title: Long pause ratio
optional_indicator_docs.clinical_meaning: Normalizes long pauses by child utterance count.
optional_indicator_docs.caveat: Can reflect task structure or recording artifacts.

optional_indicator_docs.title: Therapist utterances
optional_indicator_docs.formula: Count of therapist or investigator utterances
optional_indicator_docs.clinical_meaning: Helps interpret child language values relative to adult prompting.
optional_indicator_docs.caveat: Not an ASD marker by itself.

optional_indicator_docs.title: Caregiver utterances
optional_indicator_docs.formula: Count of parent or caregiver utterances

optional_indicator_docs.title: Turn-taking transitions
optional_indicator_docs.clinical_meaning: Adds descriptive context about reciprocal interaction.
optional_indicator_docs.caveat: Requires correct speaker diarization and transcript review.

optional_indicator_docs.title: Average response latency
optional_indicator_docs.formula: Mean gap between adjacent utterance end/start timestamps
optional_indicator_docs.clinical_meaning: Adds descriptive timing context for conversational response.
optional_indicator_docs.caveat: Requires reliable timestamps; do not compare across unlike tasks.

optional_indicator_docs.title: Restricted-interest word count
optional_indicator_docs.formula: Count of words from a reviewable restricted-interest lexicon
optional_indicator_docs.clinical_meaning: Flags possible topic clustering for therapist review.
optional_indicator_docs.caveat: Optional indicator only; not part of the core 14-feature schema.
